content.text:
* OTA-DRIVE-SKY130 v6
* Two-stage Miller OTA: NMOS input pair + fast PMOS mirror (small area, high
* mirror pole) -> matching first-stage nodes. Output stage: PMOS common-source
* with VSS-referenced NMOS current sink. Miller Cc + small series Rz.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* ---- bias network ----
XMBIAS IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=24 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XM5 TAIL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 nf=1 m=7
XM8 NREF IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=96 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XM9 NREF NREF VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XM7 VOUT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 nf=1 m=15
* ---- first stage ----
XM1 NA VINN TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=1.5 nf=1 m=7
XM2 NB VINP TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=1.5 nf=1 m=7
XM3 NA NA VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 nf=1 m=2
XM4 NB NA VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 nf=1 m=2
* ---- output stage: PMOS common source ----
XM6 VOUT NB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.25 nf=1 m=8
* ---- Miller compensation ----
RZ NB NZ 800
CC NZ VOUT 19f
.ends DUT
